'''''Aechmea coelestis''''' is a [[species]] of [[flowering plant]] in the family ''[[Bromeliaceae]]''.<ref name=POWO>{{cite web |url= https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:121596-1 |title= Aechmea coelestis (K.Koch) Jacob-Makoy |author=<!--Not stated--> |date=n.d. |website=Plants of the World Online |publisher=The Trustees of the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew |access-date=May 12, 2025}}</ref><ref name=COL>{{cite web |url= https://www.catalogueoflife.org/data/taxon/9JQTH |title= Aechmea coelestis (K.Koch) Jacob-Makoy |author=<!--Not stated--> |date=n.d. |website=Catalogue of Life |publisher=Species 2000 |access-date=May 12, 2025}}</ref> It is [[Native plant|native]] to southeastern [[Brazil]] from [[Espírito Santo]] to [[Santa Catarina (state)|Santa Catarina]].<ref name=a>[http://apps.kew.org/wcsp/namedetail.do?name_id=217885 Kew World Checklist of Selected Plant Families]</ref><ref>Sant'Ana Melhem, T., das Graças Lapa Wanderley, M., Ehlin Martins, S., Jung-Mendaçolli, S.L., Shepherd, G.J. & Kirizawa, M. (eds.) (2007). Flora Fanerogâmica do Estado de São Paulo 5: 1-476. Instituto de Botânica, São Paulo.</ref><ref>da Costa, A.F. & Wendt, T. (2007). Rodriguésia; Revista do Instituto de Biologia Vegetal, Jardim Botânico e Estaçao Biologica do Itatiaya 58: 905-939.</ref><ref>Martinelli, G., Magalhães Vieira, C., Gonzalez, M., Leitman, P., Piratininga, A.
